card.name: Inside numbers and their units
card.fires_on: Punctuation or unit words in the middle of a number, such as the decimal point or comma after a leading digit, or "mg" right after a digit. It fires mostly in dose, volume and file-size figures.

modes.label: Decimal point or comma
modes.description: The point or comma right after the first digit(s) of a number, before the rest of the figure.

modes.label: Unit after a digit
modes.description: A unit word such as mg or seconds right after a small number, before a per-kg or time phrase.
